description: The FanTail Imagine peeling an onion – layer by layer – revealing deeper insights at each level. That’s precisely what our Fantail does but without the tears! Each layer tells a part of your data story from the core to the outer rings, making it simple to grasp even the most complex hierarchies. The dynamic and enticing drill down encourages interaction and investigation of your data by all levels of leadership. The rings in the chart are divided based on their hierarchical relationship to the parent node, having multiple segments, showing the contribution of a particular dimension in that hierarchy. Great Scenarios to Use the FanTail: Sales Data: Visualise sales breakdowns (sector width) and call success rates (sector color) by state, region, and salesperson. Instantly identify key statistics, providing insights into landing paths, revenue sources, and more. Website Analytics: Visualise website traffic patterns, user engagement metrics, and conversion rates. Break down data into hierarchical segments to identify areas for improvement and optimise user experience. Financial Reports: Present complex financial data like revenue streams, expense categories, and profit margins.
